stem.text: Why does the red blood cell count increase in humans as they start living at high altitude?

A.text: to allow more carbon dioxide to be excreted by the lungs, preventing a fall in blood pH

B.text: to allow more oxygen to be taken up by the haemoglobin as the partial pressure of oxygen is lower

C.text: to allow more oxygen to be taken up by the lungs as there is a lower percentage of oxygen in the air

D.text: to allow more oxygen to be transported as the affinity of haemoglobin for oxygen is lowered
